title: Bitcoin’s Redistribution of Wealth
summary: This episode explores the mechanisms of redistribution of wealth both in the traditional financial world and within the realm of Bitcoin. It demystifies how the powers that be control the world, shaping it by force while giving the appearance of free will. It dives deep into the topic of genetic engineering and shows how Bitcoin is God's provision for people today to defend themselves against those who would destroy them. The Bitcoin ETF is noted as a legitimizing force as well as the means by which BlackRock will potentially fork the blockchain to bring Bitcoin under central control.
